verdict.rationale: Typesense states that the complete API surface of its server is open source under GPL-3.0 and free to self-host. The public GitHub repository (typesense/typesense) is cited, and an HN commenter independently confirms reading the C++ code, calling it "simple enough to skim." Missing for 10: direct evidence of the repository's LICENSE file itself, and clarity on whether Typesense Cloud-only components (dashboard, RBAC, SSO) are also open source.
